kebabKielce.lead: Szef Donald is a small kebab place at ul. Ks. Piotra Ściegiennego 68a in Kielce. We opened in 2019 and have made everything on site from day one — we have no freezer. Order your kebab with {fee} delivery, take it away or eat in.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: We are a small local restaurant in Kielce, not a chain. The people behind the counter are the same people who chop the vegetables and prepare the meat in the morning, so we know what goes into every wrap, pita and bun.
In season we serve around {wraps} wraps a week. That is a lot for a small place, and it lets us prepare meat and salads fresh every day instead of storing them for weeks.

sections.heading: What makes us different
paragraphs: We have no freezer. Meat, salads, sauces and falafel are prepared during the day, and whatever we do not sell does not come back to the counter tomorrow. We go for big portions, well-seasoned meat and fresh vegetables.
bullets: Everything made on site, at Ściegiennego 68a.
Choice of meat: chicken, beef or mixed.
Three sauces: mild, spicy and mixed — if you like it really hot, say so in the order notes.
Several portion sizes — the meat weight of each size is listed on the menu.
Vegetarian option: falafel in a wrap, pita, bun or on a plate.

sections.heading: Which kebab can you order
paragraphs: The classics are kebab in a tortilla wrap, in pita and in a bun — meat, salad and sauce. If you prefer a fork, go for the kebab plate with fries and salad, the kebab box or the kebab salad. For a big appetite there is kapsalon: meat, fries, cheese and sauce in one box. The menu also has fryto kebab, tacos with chicken tenders and combo deals with a drink at a lower price.
Current prices and the meat weight of every size are listed below and on the full menu — they come straight from our ordering system, so they are always up to date.

falafelKielce.lead: Looking for falafel in Kielce? At Szef Donald, ul. Ks. Piotra Ściegiennego 68a, falafel is a proper dish, not a side. We serve it in a tortilla wrap, in pita, in a bun or on a plate — with salad and your choice of sauce.

sections.heading: Falafel made on site
paragraphs: We make falafel at the restaurant during the day, like the rest of the menu — we have no freezer. Falafel dishes are vegetarian: no meat, so a good choice if you skip kebab or are ordering for a mixed group.
You choose the portion by the number of falafel pieces — from standard to Mega. Plus salad and a sauce: mild, spicy or mixed.

kapsalonKielce.lead: Kapsalon is a Dutch dish: kebab meat, fries, cheese and sauce served together in one box. In Kielce you can eat it at Szef Donald, ul. Ks. Piotra Ściegiennego 68a — or order it with {fee} delivery.

sections.heading: What is in a kapsalon
paragraphs: Fries go at the bottom, then kebab meat, cheese and sauce. You choose the meat — chicken, beef or mixed — and the sauce: mild, spicy or mixed. It is one of the most filling dishes on our menu; portion sizes and meat weights are listed below.
Everything is prepared on site during the day — we have no freezer.
